svg.title: ContextGem: effortless LLM extraction from documents
svg.desc: A pixel-art meadow in a wooden frame. On a path on the right, the duck in a hard hat reads a document on its clipboard and holds up a blue gem it found. Crates of documents stand beside the path, and a mine cart heaped with gems stands on it. The duck thinks of the ContextGem wordmark, the line "Effortless LLM extraction from documents", "Automated prompts", "Minimal code · Multi-model" and "Shcherbak AI".
